column5: rationale
Package-manager dependency trees are not Nimbus-owned source.
Cargo build artifacts are not source.
Bundled build outputs are verified by package/build gates, not source-size gates.
Storybook static bundles are generated UI artifacts.
Local Nimbus app artifacts are generated.
Convex generated API/data model outputs are regenerated from source.
Generated protobuf/client sources are tracked output, not hand-owned logic.
Imported Node compatibility fixtures are evidence corpus, not Nimbus-owned source.
Browser demo vendor bundle is third-party/generated artifact.
Proof screenshots and evidence artifacts are not source modules.
Firebase compatibility selftest is capability-owned but too large for long-term maintenance; split by behavior while preserving coverage.
Node compatibility bootstrap is product-owned runtime code above the hard threshold; split by capability or document a strong runtime-bootstrap exception.
System tenant mixes reserved tenant helpers, schemas, projection observation, and record writers; split by evidence concept.
Dev command owns args, app-dir setup, env/deployment, readiness, browser launch, banner, and watch loop; split by workflow phase.
Runtime limits mixes backend axes, diagnostics, grants, budgets, and routing affinity; split by runtime policy axis.
Service manager mixes verification, activation, launch, refresh, runtime binding, and system-state recording; keep facade thin.
Operator policy mixes document/defaulting, validation, evaluation, explanation/diff, reload, external backend, and prover behavior.
Runtime-local ops should be grouped by host capability family for reviewability.
Cloud Functions HTTP adapter should be grouped by request parsing, signature binding, execution handoff, and response mapping.
